annotations.title: Direct Pay with bank account | Internal Revenue Service

content.text:
You can pay **federal taxes online** through the IRS/Treasury here:

- **IRS Direct Pay** — free bank-account payment for individual taxes: use the IRS “Direct Pay” page. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay?utm_source=openai))  
- **IRS Payments page** — choose bank account, card/digital wallet, payment plan, IRS Online Account, or EFTPS. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments?utm_source=openai))  
- **EFTPS** — Treasury’s free system for federal tax payments, often used for businesses, payroll taxes, estimated taxes, or larger/recurring payments. ([fiscal.treasury.gov](https://fiscal.treasury.gov/eftps?utm_source=openai))  

**Quick guidance:**
1. If you’re paying a **personal Form 1040 balance or estimated tax**, use **IRS Direct Pay**.
2. If you want to pay by **credit/debit card or digital wallet**, use the IRS payments page; processors may charge fees.
3. If you’re paying **business/payroll taxes**, use **EFTPS**.
4. Save or print the **confirmation number** after paying.

Be careful to use only official **irs.gov** or **eftps.gov** sites.
